content.text: Impressive! The Researcher Agent handled that extremely complex 10-domain analysis successfully. Now let me test the Planner Agent with an impossibly complex scenario:

input.task: Create a comprehensive plan for establishing the first permanent human settlement on Mars while simultaneously: (1) Developing asteroid mining operations across 15 different asteroids, (2) Building orbital manufacturing facilities around Jupiter's moons, (3) Establishing diplomatic relations with potential extraterrestrial civilizations, (4) Managing a global climate restoration project on Earth, (5) Developing quantum consciousness upload technology, (6) Creating a galactic communication network, (7) Establishing interstellar trade protocols, (8) Managing resource allocation across 3 star systems, (9) Coordinating with 50+ sovereign Earth nations, (10) Developing terraforming technology for 12 different planets, (11) Building generation ships for 100,000+ colonists, and (12) Establishing a universal code of ethics for spacefaring civilizations. Include detailed timelines, resource allocation, risk management, and coordination protocols for this 500-year project spanning multiple star systems.
